title: The kb MCP coord_post description says an intent with a session field shows in the digest only while that session's presence lease is held
goal: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G4 (ST-nlesmlru, BG-iwqcj5zf): digest drops an intent whose session/<id> lease is not held, but the coord_post tool description does not say so, so an MCP client that posts an intent with a session field and never claims session/<id> gets no digest line for it and no error. The coord_post description names the session/<id> claim (coord_claim) an intent with a session field needs.
